description: Retention configuration for Kiero diagnostics (I2). The accepted policy: redacted technical events are retained 30 days. Enforcement is two-sided and BOTH sides are recorded honestly: Convex-side windowed pruning (retention.ts + pruneExpired) and the Axiom dataset retention setting (30 days is the Personal-plan default). Axiom dataset trimming operates on storage blocks, so the setting is not evidence of exact per-event physical deletion at a boundary - dashboards must state the window, not promise byte-exact expiry.

diagnosticEvents.enforcedBy: convex pruneExpired mutation (bounded batches, every telemetry tick)
diagnosticEvents.sinkSide: axiom dataset retention 30 days (Personal default; verify after provisioning)

healthHeartbeats.enforcedBy: heartbeat recorder prunes the tail on every insert

costAccounting.note: Cost entries/alert states are accounting, not diagnostics; they outlive the diagnostic window so the 400/500 PLN budget history survives.

canonicalRecords: Domain and audit tables are NOT affected by these windows; telemetry is best effort and never audit history.
